name: pac-bench-for-refusals
description: A safety-focused benchmark that measures whether models appropriately refuse or comply with harmful, unsafe, or disallowed user prompts. It contains prompts designed to probe refusal behavior and evaluates model replies for correct refusal behavior and safe handling. Useful for assessing alignment and safety guardrails in LLMs.
reputation: A niche safety dataset used for refusal/alignment testing with limited but growing adoption among alignment researchers.
